content: ज्ञानम् [ज्ञा-भावे ल्युट्] .²1 Knowing, understanding, becoming acquainted with, proficiency; सांख्यस्य योगस्य चज्ञानम् <ls>Māl. 1. 7</ls>. .²2 Knowledge, learning; तथेन्द्रियाकुलीभावे ज्ञेयं ज्ञानेन शुध्यति <ls>Mb. 12. 204. 2</ls>; बुद्धिर्ज्ञानेन शुध्यति <ls>Ms. 5. 109</ls>; ज्ञाने मौनं क्षमा शत्रौ <ls>R. 1. 22</ls>. .²3 Consciousness, cognizance, knowledge; ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतो वापि <ls>Ms. 8. 288</ls> knowingly or unknowingly, consciously or unconsciously. .²4 Sacred knowledge; especially, knowledge derived form meditation on the higher truths of religion and philosophy which teaches man how to understand his own nature and how he may be reunited to the Supreme Spirit (<ab>opp.</ab> कर्मन्); <ab>cf.</ab> ज्ञानयोग and कर्मयोग in <ls>Bg. 3. 3</ls>. .²5 The organ of intelligence, sense, intellect; कच्चिज्ज्ञानानि सर्वाणि प्रसन्नानि तवाच्युत <ls>Mb. 12. 45. 18</ls>. .²6 Conscience. .²7 The Supreme spirit. .²8 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .²9 The Vedas taken collectively. .²10 Means of knowing; औत्पत्तिकस्तु शब्दस्यार्थेन सम्बन्धस्तस्य ज्ञानम्˚ . <ls>MS. 1. 1. 5</ls>. .²11 An opinion, a view; बलदेवस्य वाक्यं तु मम ज्ञाने न युज्यते <ls>Mb. 5. 4. 3</ls>.
